sources.title: Meta Releases Muse Spark Open: 816B Open-Weight MoE With 1M Context
sources.snippet: Meta Superintelligence Labs has released Muse Spark Open, the open-weight version of its Muse Spark model. Muse Spark Open is an 816B-parameter Mixture-of-Experts model that activates 42B parameters per token. It takes text, image, video and audio input, returns text, and holds a 1M-token context window.
